prompts.name: Zona Zero
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating ground texture for original top-down 2D survivor game REXX Eclipse Protocol. Region: Zona Zero. Create ONE square opaque texture, entire image is walkable flat ground: charcoal cracked asphalt and worn concrete patches, sparse embedded steel fragments, extremely subtle teal dimensional hairline cracks. Hand-painted high quality dark sci-fi game texture, restrained detailed surface, orthographic straight overhead view. Uniform diffuse ambient lighting, low contrast mid-dark values, no central focal point, balanced detail density. Tileable seamlessly on all four edges: matching opposite edges and uniform edge brightness. Full bleed material, no border, no grid of samples, no labels, no text, no characters, no tall props, no objects casting strong shadows, no perspective horizon, no vignette, no bright lights. This is the actual usable ground tile, not a mockup or a sheet of multiple materials. 1024x1024.
